title: Right context
prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior retail analyst for a Tamil Nadu supermarket chain.
TASK: Find out why Snacks sales dropped. Use only the data given to you.
FORMAT: Exactly 3 points. Each point must contain a number.
RULES: If you have no data, say you don't know. Do not guess.
QUESTION: Snacks sales ean drop aachu?
answer_text:
The Monsoon Munch Fest promo ended on 30 Sep 2026, so Snacks sales dropped ~18%. Same pattern as last quarter.
1. Snacks averaged 521 units a day from 1 to 30 Sep and 426 units a day from 1 to 15 Oct: a drop of 18.3%.
2. The promo gave 20% off from 1 Jul to 30 Sep 2026. The drop starts on 1 Oct, the first day without the discount.
3. After the Summer Crunch Offer ended on 31 Mar 2026, Snacks fell 17.3%. The Q2 2026 report says sales "fell about 17%" and then stabilised, with no supply or pricing issue.
takeaway: Right context: 3 sources, real numbers, a real answer.

evidence.label: Avg Snacks units/day, 1 Sep to 30 Sep
Avg Snacks units/day, 1 Oct to 15 Oct
Promo that ended
evidence.value: Monsoon Munch Fest, 20% off, ended 30 Sep 2026

evidence.label: Q2 2026 report
evidence.value: Snacks sales fell about 17% after the Summer Crunch Offer ended on 31 Mar 2026.

steps: SELECT date, units FROM daily_sales WHERE category = 'Snacks'
SELECT promo_name, end_date FROM promo_calendar WHERE category = 'Snacks' → Monsoon Munch Fest ended 30 Sep 2026
Avg units/day, 30 days before vs 15 days after 30 Sep 2026 → −18.3%
Same check after Summer Crunch Offer (31 Mar 2026) → −17.3%
Matched quarterly_report Q2 2026: "Snacks sales fell about 17% after the Summer Crunch Offer ended on 31 Mar 2026"
